key_insight: AdvancedMathBench fills a major gap in math AI evaluation by testing not just final answers, but whether models can generate and verify advanced mathematical proofs across a broad range of disciplines. It aims to reveal how well LLMs reason in serious mathematics, not just solve standard competition problems.
problem_solved: Current math benchmarks mostly cover high-school or olympiad-style problems and often judge models only by final-answer correctness. This paper addresses the lack of broad disciplinary coverage and fine-grained evaluation for advanced mathematical proof generation and verification.
method: Introduces a benchmark suite focused on advanced mathematical proof generation and verification.
Expands evaluation beyond final answers to assess reasoning validity and proof quality.
Provides broader disciplinary coverage to better reflect the difficulty and diversity of advanced mathematics.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this benchmark offers a more realistic way to measure mathematical reasoning capabilities and identify weaknesses in proof-based reasoning. It can guide model development toward stronger, more trustworthy reasoning in advanced math domains.

paper_title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
paper_authors: Lingkai Kong, Zijian Wu, Yuzhe Gu, Haiteng Zhao, Wenyong Huang
